subheadings.rawText: Founding engineer with 4+ years building scalable, multi-tenant web applications end-to-end (database to UI) using \textbf{TypeScript}, \textbf{React/Next.js}, \textbf{Python/FastAPI}, and \textbf{PostgreSQL}. Shipped AI, real-time, and growth features across \textbf{88 tenants} and \textbf{38,000+ users} on \textbf{GCP}.

resumeItems: \textbf{Languages & Frameworks:} TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Node.js
\textbf{Cloud & DevOps:} GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub), AWS (EC2, ElastiCache), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions.
\textbf{Tools:} PostgreSQL, Redis, PostHog, Prometheus, React Query, Tailwind CSS, Firebase.

subheadings.position: Founding Engineer, Product | Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Query, GCP
resumeItems: Engineered a crash-resistant \textbf{medical AI scribe} with IndexedDB persistence and exponential backoff, used across \textbf{104K+ sessions} and generating \textbf{81K+ AI notes}, saving medical professionals \textbf{13,000+ hours}.
Rewrote our \textbf{online booking}, scaling it \textbf{2x} to \textbf{2,500 bookings/month} across \textbf{29 clinics} and for \textbf{179K+ patients}.

Built an end-to-end \textbf{email platform} with a reusable WYSIWYG composer, delivery and engagement tracking, enabling \textbf{email marketing campaigns} reaching \textbf{32K+ recipients} across \textbf{12 campaigns} and sending \textbf{94K+ emails}.
Designed the \textbf{drag-and-drop scheduling builder} powering \textbf{49 clinics} to create \textbf{700K+ complex, multi-service appointments} with equipment booking, clean-up and prep time logic
Built the company's first \textbf{observability stack} ingesting \textbf{37.8M events} via PostHog with a \textbf{118-event taxonomy}.

Architected a \textbf{typed, cross-store internal product adoption platform} unifying \textbf{Postgres} and \textbf{PostHog} behind a \textbf{FastAPI} query registry, exposing \textbf{142 metrics} across \textbf{18 product modules} as the foundation for customer-health scoring and net-revenue-retention tracking.

Drove company-wide adoption of \textbf{React Query}, establishing patterns for cache invalidation, optimistic updates, and mutation handling resulting in instant page loads while eliminating stale data bugs via stale-while-revalidate caching.
